english.note: This is the everyday choice when a quantity has become less; it is the all-purpose colloquial equivalent when decrease means become smaller.

exampleSentences.english: I recently noticed my pay decrease.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 gan6 faat3 gok3 fan6 loeng4 siu2 zo2

english.note: Use this casual expression when something has itself become less, rather than when someone actively reduces it.

exampleSentences.english: All this recent rain has made the number of people on the streets lessen.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢排落雨，街上嘅人少咗。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 paai4 lok6 jyu5 gaai1 soeng6 ge3 jan4 siu2 zo2
